name: arch hang
description: A hang from a bar where you pull the shoulder blades down and back and lift the chest toward the bar. It teaches the top half of a pull-up and strengthens the upper back.
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and a shoulder-width grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together without bending your elbows.
Lift your chest toward the bar so your upper back arches.
Hold for a breath at the top.
Lower back to a relaxed hang with control.
